lessons.title: The Scholarship She Almost Missed
lessons.titleNative: La bourse qu'elle a failli manquer
lessons.context: A story using si-clauses and the past subjunctive.

paragraphs.fr: Si Camille n'avait pas vérifié ses courriels ce soir-là, elle aurait raté la date limite de la bourse.
paragraphs.en: If Camille hadn't checked her email that night, she would have missed the scholarship deadline.

paragraphs.fr: Elle doutait d'avoir la moindre chance, étant donné qu'il y avait des centaines de candidats.
paragraphs.en: She doubted she had any chance, since there were hundreds of candidates.

paragraphs.fr: Cependant, ses professeurs lui avaient conseillé de postuler quand même.
paragraphs.en: However, her teachers had recommended that she apply anyway.

paragraphs.fr: Des mois plus tard, elle a reçu la nouvelle qui allait changer sa vie complètement.
paragraphs.en: Months later, she received the news that would completely change her life.

paragraphs.fr: Aujourd'hui, quand quelqu'un doute de ses propres capacités, elle leur raconte toujours cette histoire.
paragraphs.en: Now, when someone doubts their own abilities, she always tells them this story.

questions.question: What would have happened if Camille hadn't checked her email?
options: She would have missed the deadline

questions.question: Why did she doubt her chances?
What did her teachers recommend?
What does she do now when someone doubts themselves?

lessons.title: The Village Council Debate
lessons.titleNative: Le débat du conseil du village
lessons.context: A story using subjunctive in adverbial clauses and advanced connectors.

paragraphs.fr: Quand le projet de la nouvelle route a été annoncé, le village s'est divisé en deux.
paragraphs.en: When the new highway project was announced, the town split into two.

paragraphs.fr: Certains soutenaient l'idée puisqu'elle apporterait plus d'emplois dans la région.
paragraphs.en: Some supported the idea since it would bring more jobs to the area.

paragraphs.fr: D'autres, cependant, craignaient qu'elle ne détruise la forêt voisine.
paragraphs.en: Others, however, feared it would destroy the nearby forest.

paragraphs.fr: Malgré leurs différences, tout le monde a accepté d'attendre qu'une étude environnementale soit faite.
paragraphs.en: Despite the differences, everyone agreed to wait until an environmental study was done.

paragraphs.fr: Par conséquent, la décision finale a été reportée de plusieurs mois.
paragraphs.en: Therefore, the final decision was postponed several months.

questions.question: Why did the town split into two?
Why did some support the project?
What did others fear?
options: That it would destroy the nearby forest
That it would be too fast
That it would be too slow

questions.question: What did everyone agree to do?

lessons.title: A Life Reconsidered
lessons.context: A reflective story using layered hypotheticals.

paragraphs.fr: S'il avait suivi le conseil de son père, Antoine serait comptable aujourd'hui.
paragraphs.en: If he had followed his father's advice, Antoine would be an accountant today.

paragraphs.fr: Au lieu de cela, il a décidé d'étudier l'art, bien qu'il sache que ce serait un chemin plus incertain.
paragraphs.en: Instead, he decided to study art, even though he knew it would be a more uncertain path.

paragraphs.fr: Il y a eu des moments où il doutait d'avoir pris la bonne décision.
paragraphs.en: There were moments when he doubted he had made the right decision.

paragraphs.fr: Néanmoins, quand il voit ses tableaux exposés dans une galerie, il sait que cela en valait la peine.
paragraphs.en: However, when he sees his paintings displayed in a gallery, he knows it was worth it.

paragraphs.fr: Malgré les sacrifices, il ne changerait jamais le chemin qu'il a choisi.
paragraphs.en: Despite the sacrifices, he would never change the path he chose.

questions.question: What would Antoine be if he had followed his father's advice?
What did he decide to study instead?
What did he sometimes doubt?
options: That he had made the right decision

questions.question: How does he feel about his choice now?

lessons.title: The Letter That Waited
lessons.context: A story using the subjunctive across multiple tenses.

paragraphs.fr: Ma grand-mère a gardé une lettre pendant cinquante ans, espérant qu'un jour elle pourrait la remettre.
paragraphs.en: My grandmother kept a letter for fifty years, hoping that someday she could deliver it.

paragraphs.fr: C'était une lettre que sa sœur lui avait écrite avant que la famille n'émigre.
paragraphs.en: It was a letter her sister had written before the family emigrated.

paragraphs.fr: Bien qu'elles aient perdu contact pendant des décennies, elle n'a jamais cessé de croire qu'elles se retrouveraient.
paragraphs.en: Although they lost contact for decades, she never stopped believing they would reunite.

paragraphs.fr: Quand elle l'a enfin retrouvée, elles étaient toutes deux âgées, mais leur étreinte fut aussi forte que si le temps ne s'était pas écoulé.
paragraphs.en: When she finally found her, they were both elderly, but the hug was as strong as if no time had passed.

paragraphs.fr: J'aimerais que nous ayons tous la patience et la foi qu'avait ma grand-mère.
paragraphs.en: I wish we all had the patience and faith my grandmother had.

questions.question: How long did the grandmother keep the letter?
Who wrote the letter?
What did the grandmother never stop believing?
options: That she would forget her sister
That the letter was lost forever

questions.question: What does the writer wish?
options: To have the same patience and faith

lessons.title: The Startup That Almost Failed
lessons.titleNative: La startup qui a failli échouer
lessons.context: A business story using si-clauses and connectors.

paragraphs.fr: Si les fondateurs n'avaient pas changé de stratégie à temps, l'entreprise aurait fait faillite.
paragraphs.en: If the founders hadn't changed strategy in time, the company would have gone bankrupt.

paragraphs.fr: Étant donné que le premier produit n'a pas fonctionné comme prévu, ils ont décidé d'écouter leurs clients.
paragraphs.en: Given that the first product didn't work as expected, they decided to listen to their customers.

paragraphs.fr: Bien que de nombreux investisseurs aient perdu confiance, un petit groupe a décidé de miser sur eux.
paragraphs.en: Although many investors lost confidence, a small group decided to bet on them.

paragraphs.fr: Grâce à ce soutien, ils ont réussi à développer un produit qui résolvait un vrai problème.
paragraphs.en: Thanks to that support, they managed to develop a product that actually solved a real problem.

paragraphs.fr: Aujourd'hui, cette entreprise emploie des centaines de personnes à des postes qui n'existaient même pas auparavant.
paragraphs.en: Today, that company employs hundreds of people in jobs that didn't even exist before.

questions.question: What would have happened if the founders hadn't changed strategy?
options: The company would have gone bankrupt
They would have gotten rich immediately
They would have sold the company

questions.question: Why did they decide to listen to customers?
options: Their first product didn't work as expected

questions.question: What did a small group of investors do?
What does the company do today?

lessons.title: A Philosopher's Walk
lessons.context: A reflective, abstract story built around philosophical vocabulary.

paragraphs.fr: Chaque après-midi, le vieux professeur marchait sur le même chemin, pensant à des questions sans réponse facile.
paragraphs.en: Every afternoon, the old professor walked the same path, thinking about questions without easy answers.

paragraphs.fr: Il se demandait si le temps existait vraiment ou si ce n'était qu'une façon pour l'esprit d'organiser l'expérience.
paragraphs.en: He wondered whether time really existed or was just a way the mind organized experience.

paragraphs.fr: Bien qu'il n'ait jamais trouvé de réponse définitive, il aimait le processus de questionnement.
paragraphs.en: Although he never found a definitive answer, he enjoyed the process of questioning.

paragraphs.fr: Il disait que la sagesse ne consistait pas à avoir toutes les réponses, mais à savoir poser les bonnes questions.
paragraphs.en: He used to say wisdom didn't consist of having all the answers, but of knowing how to ask the right questions.

paragraphs.fr: Ses étudiants, puisqu'ils l'admiraient tant, continuaient à lui rendre visite bien après avoir obtenu leur diplôme.
paragraphs.en: His students, since they admired him so much, kept visiting him long after graduating.

questions.question: What did the professor do every afternoon?
What did he wonder about?
What did he enjoy despite never finding a definitive answer?
What did he say wisdom consisted of?
options: Knowing how to ask the right questions

lessons.title: The Neighborhood That Rebuilt Itself
lessons.titleNative: Le quartier qui s'est reconstruit lui-même
lessons.context: A community story using passive voice, connectors, and subjunctive.

paragraphs.fr: Après que l'incendie a détruit la moitié du pâté de maisons, beaucoup pensaient que le quartier ne s'en remettrait jamais.
paragraphs.en: After the fire destroyed half the block, many thought the neighborhood would never recover.

paragraphs.fr: Cependant, puisque les voisins ont refusé d'abandonner, ils ont commencé à reconstruire ensemble.
paragraphs.en: However, since the neighbors refused to give up, they began rebuilding together.

paragraphs.fr: Ils se sont organisés pour que chaque famille reçoive l'aide dont elle avait besoin.
paragraphs.en: They organized so that each family would receive the help it needed.

paragraphs.fr: Bien que cela ait pris plus d'un an, le quartier est ressorti encore plus uni qu'avant.
paragraphs.en: Although it took more than a year, the neighborhood ended up even more united than before.

paragraphs.fr: Aujourd'hui, quand quelqu'un passe dans cette rue, il est difficile d'imaginer qu'une tragédie y ait eu lieu.
paragraphs.en: Today, when someone walks down that street, it's hard to imagine there was ever a tragedy there.

questions.question: What destroyed half the block?
What did many people think at first?
Why did the neighbors start rebuilding?
How did the neighborhood end up?

lessons.title: The Interview That Almost Didn't Happen
lessons.titleNative: L'entretien qui a failli ne pas avoir lieu
lessons.context: A story combining multiple B2 grammar points naturally.

paragraphs.fr: Si le journaliste n'avait pas tant insisté, le célèbre écrivain n'aurait jamais accepté l'entretien.
paragraphs.en: If the journalist hadn't insisted so much, the famous writer would never have accepted the interview.

paragraphs.fr: Étant donné que l'écrivain parlait rarement à la presse, beaucoup doutaient que ce soit possible.
paragraphs.en: Given that the writer rarely spoke to the press, many doubted it would be possible.

paragraphs.fr: Cependant, quand ils se sont finalement assis pour discuter, ils ont parlé pendant des heures sans qu'aucun des deux ne remarque le temps.
paragraphs.en: However, when they finally sat down to talk, they spoke for hours without either noticing the time.

paragraphs.fr: L'écrivain a avoué que, malgré sa réputation d'être distant, il appréciait en réalité beaucoup les bonnes conversations.
paragraphs.en: The writer confessed that, despite his reputation for being distant, he actually enjoyed good conversations a lot.

paragraphs.fr: Cet entretien est devenu, avec le temps, l'un des plus lus de la décennie.
paragraphs.en: That interview became, over time, one of the most read of the decade.

questions.question: What would have happened without the journalist's insistence?
options: The writer would never have accepted

questions.question: Why did many doubt the interview was possible?
options: He rarely spoke to the press

questions.question: What did they do once they started talking?
options: Talked for hours without noticing the time

questions.question: What did the interview become?
options: One of the most read of the decade

lessons.title: A Reflection on Change
lessons.context: A philosophical, reflective story reviewing abstract B2 vocabulary.

paragraphs.fr: Bien que nous ayons peur du changement, étant donné qu'il représente l'inconnu, c'est aussi ce qui nous fait grandir.
paragraphs.en: Although we fear change, since it represents the unknown, it's also what makes us grow.

paragraphs.fr: Si nous ne changions jamais, nous serions exactement les mêmes personnes qu'il y a vingt ans.
paragraphs.en: If we never changed, we would be exactly the same people we were twenty years ago.

paragraphs.fr: Alors que certains résistent au changement de toutes leurs forces, d'autres l'accueillent comme une opportunité.
paragraphs.en: While some resist change with all their strength, others welcome it as an opportunity.

paragraphs.fr: Puisque rien ne reste pareil pour toujours, peut-être que la chose la plus sage est d'apprendre à vivre avec le courant.
paragraphs.en: Since nothing stays the same forever, perhaps the wisest thing is to learn to flow with life.

paragraphs.fr: J'aimerais que nous puissions tous voir le changement non pas comme une perte, mais comme une porte vers quelque chose de nouveau.
paragraphs.en: I wish we could all see change not as a loss, but as a door to something new.

questions.question: Why do we fear change according to the passage?
What would we be if we never changed?
options: The same people we were twenty years ago

questions.question: How do some people receive change?
What does the writer wish we could see change as?

lessons.title: The Journey Continues
lessons.context: A capstone reflective story reviewing B2's key grammar in context.

paragraphs.fr: Si tu m'avais dit il y a un an que j'irais aussi loin, je ne l'aurais pas cru.
paragraphs.en: If you had told me a year ago that I would get this far, I wouldn't have believed it.

paragraphs.fr: Bien que le chemin ait été plein de doutes, étant donné que j'ai continué à pratiquer chaque jour, tout a commencé à avoir du sens.
paragraphs.en: Although the road was full of doubts, since I kept practicing every day, everything started to make sense.

paragraphs.fr: Cependant, je sais qu'il reste encore beaucoup à apprendre, et cela, loin de m'épuiser, me remplit d'énergie.
paragraphs.en: However, I know there's still much to learn, and that, far from exhausting me, excites me.

paragraphs.fr: J'espère que tu continueras avec la même curiosité qui t'a amené jusqu'ici.
paragraphs.en: I hope you continue with the same curiosity that brought you to this point.

paragraphs.fr: Quoi qu'il arrive ensuite, tu as déjà prouvé que tu peux y arriver.
paragraphs.en: Whatever comes next, you've already shown that you can achieve it.

questions.question: How does the writer feel about a year ago?
options: They wouldn't have believed how far they'd come

questions.question: What helped things start making sense?
How does the writer feel about what's left to learn?
What has the reader already shown, according to the writer?
